text:
SY332
Sociology of Race and Ethnicity
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
Drawing on critical race theory and studies of ethnicity, this
course
examines social diversity in Canada with an emphasis on race and ethnic relations. Topics include representations of racial difference, institutional racism, colonialism, and policies of immigration and multiculturalism.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
SY101
and one of:

,

,

, (or SY204*),
